description: Evidence-backed negative result for intent i005 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=xsk-umem-fetch). Searched snapshots/s04 only. Key evidence: (1) The seed's vulnerable feature does not exist in s04 — grep across the whole tree finds zero occurrences of xsk_tx_metadata, XDP_TXMD_FLAGS_*, tx_metadata_len, tx_sw_csum, or csum_start/csum_offset in net/xdp, and include/uapi/linux/if_xdp.h has no struct xsk_tx_metadata or TX metadata option; s04's AF_XDP predates commit 48eb03dd2630. (2) The general descriptor double-fetch invariant is enforced correctly everywhere in s04's AF_XDP TX/RX path: net/xdp/xsk_queue.h:191-211 xskq_cons_read_desc() copies each struct xdp_desc from the user-mmap'd TX ring into a private kernel struct in a single assignment ('*desc = ring->desc[idx];' line 199) and then validates only that private copy (xskq_cons_is_valid_desc -> xp_aligned_validate_desc line 133 / xp_unaligned_validate_desc line 153); xskq_cons_read_desc_batch() (lines 214-236, copy at 224) copies into kvcalloc'd pool->tx_descs; fill-ring addresses are fetched once into locals via __xskq_cons_read_addr_unchecked (line 115) and validated via xp_check_unaligned/xp_check_aligned (xsk_buff_pool.c:409-421); bounds arithmetic uses 48-bit base + 16-bit offset so no u64 wrap can bypass. (3) All consumers use the validated private copies: net/xdp/xsk.c xsk_build_skb (line 489) / xsk_build_skb_zerocopy (line 443), xsk_tx_peek_desc (line 317), and drivers dpaa2-xsk.c:354/410, i40e_xsk.c:472-493, ice_xsk.c:896-924, igc_main.c:2781-2792, ixgbe_xsk.c:415-419, mlx5 en/xsk/tx.c:84-97, stmmac_main.c:2435-2445. No reportable finding; ten candidates classified (nine safe, one unresolved = the seed site itself which is structurally absent and excluded from reporting). Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i005.json with snapshots_checked=["s04"]. Limitations: only eight driver consumers read in depth (rest grep-verified against the same private-copy contract); UMEM packet-content races inherent to zero-copy DMA are out of scope; RX producer/consumer index fetches only spot-checked; vhost/af_packet/csum branches deferred to intents i006-i017.
